confidence_notes: Holistic knowledge-based estimate for a July 2026 peak-season window; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than July accommodation, which varies with events and district. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer price. FX figure comes from web search results attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates page; the page itself was not opened directly, and a 14 October figure was reported without a confirmed label, so the 13 October observation is used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used; estimates rest on Berlin-specific general knowledge within German and wider Western European city price levels, with a July peak-season uplift applied to accommodation.
